sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which electronic component is primarily used as the programmable 'brain' to process sensor inputs and control output devices in simple automation projects?
In print advertisement design, a short, memorable phrase used consistently in marketing campaigns to attract target audiences is called a ____________.
What is the primary educational objective of setting up a 'Kaushal Mela' in a school environment?
options: B) To showcase vocational skills and student-made working models
C) To conduct final written examinations
D) To recruit teachers for vocational subjects
questions.answer: B) To showcase vocational skills and student-made working models

questions.question_text: When drafting an advertisement poster, intentionally leaving empty unprinted areas around text and images to prevent visual clutter is known as using ____________ space.
In a basic smart home setup, a ____________ switch is an electromechanical device used to control high-voltage household appliances using low-voltage signals from a microcontroller.

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the concept of 'Home Automation' in the context of modern living. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Home automation refers to the centralized, automatic control of household appliances like lights and locks using microcontrollers and sensors, aimed at improving daily convenience and energy efficiency.

questions.question_text: Explain the importance of identifying a 'Target Audience' when creating a new product advertisement. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Identifying a target audience pinpoints the specific consumer group most likely to buy the product, helping creators design highly relevant visuals, slogans, and marketing messages.

questions.question_text: State two primary responsibilities of a student committee organizing exhibition stalls for a school Kaushal Mela. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The organizing committee must efficiently allocate stall spaces for various project displays and actively manage visitor crowd flow while ensuring strict safety protocols are maintained.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are designing a smart home automation project to secure a room. Outline the basic components and working steps to build a Wi-Fi-controlled door lock using an ESP32 microcontroller. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Connect an ESP32 microcontroller to a servo motor attached to the physical door mechanism. Program the ESP32 to link to a local Wi-Fi network. When an authorized user sends a wireless command via a smartphone interface, the microcontroller signals the servo to unlock the door.
